meta.title: Eris: a Matrix client for communities
meta.description: Eris is a Matrix client with servers, channels, direct messages, friends and voice calls in one familiar layout. For the web, Windows, Linux and Android.
hero.tagline: Servers, channels, DMs and voice chat on the open Matrix network.
showcase.title: A layout you already know
showcase.body: A server rail, channel lists, chat and a member list. Every conversation runs on Matrix.
showcase.chat.name: Chat
showcase.chat.body: Files, images and audio in the timeline, with @ mentions and # channel links.
showcase.voice.name: Voice
showcase.voice.body: Group voice channels run on MatrixRTC and LiveKit.
showcase.friends.name: Friends
showcase.friends.body: A friends list, direct messages and a right-click menu on every row.
showcase.switcher.name: Quick switcher
showcase.switcher.body: Press Ctrl+K and jump to a chat, a channel or a server.
showcase.roles.name: Permissions
showcase.roles.body: Choose the role each action needs, channel by channel.
showcase.login.name: Sign in
showcase.login.body: Type your Matrix ID. Eris finds your homeserver.
mock.dm.title: Direct messages
mock.chat.first: The new build is ready. Who can test the voice channel tonight?
mock.chat.second: I can. Here are the release notes.
mock.chat.third: Thanks, {user}. See you in {channel} at nine.
mock.switcher.title: Quick switcher
mock.settings.title: Server settings
mock.login.subtitle: Sign in with your Matrix account to start chatting and calling.
mock.empty.title: No messages
mock.empty.hint: Send the first message to start the conversation.
mock.home.title: Select a conversation
mock.home.body: Pick a direct message or start a new conversation.
mock.thread.dev.first: The Android build passes all tests.
mock.thread.dev.second: Good. I will write the release post.
mock.thread.bob.first: Do you have time for a call?
demo.meta.title: Eris demo: explore the app in your browser
demo.meta.description: Click through a live mock of Eris: servers, channels, direct messages, voice and permissions. All content is sample data.
demo.title: Eris demo
themes.title: Pick a look
themes.body: Every theme has a dark and a light mode. Eris can switch with your system setting.
download.title: Get Eris
download.body: Installers are on GitHub Releases. Pick your platform.
download.web.body: Run the web client from the source code.
matrix.title: Built on Matrix. Open source.
matrix.protocol.title: An open standard
matrix.protocol.body: Matrix is an open protocol for real-time communication. No single company owns the network.
matrix.homeserver.title: A server you choose
matrix.homeserver.body: Your account lives on a homeserver. Use a public one or run your own.
matrix.interop.title: Works with other clients
matrix.interop.body: Your rooms are the same in Element and other Matrix clients. Use them side by side.
matrix.source.title: Open source
matrix.source.body: Eris is built with Svelte and Tauri. The source code is public on GitHub.
cta.title: Start chatting on Matrix
cta.body: Download the latest release from GitHub.
footer.disclaimer: Eris is not affiliated with the Matrix.org Foundation.
